findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_partner_earnings, join_partner_program, deploy_model · Private data: get_market_summary, get_partner_earnings, join_partner_program, get_balance, rent_gpu, deploy_model, list_images, list_instances, get_events, schedule_removal · Public sink: get_partner_earnings, join_partner_program · Destructive: terminate_instance, schedule_removal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_partner_earnings, join_partner_program, deploy_model · Private data: get_market_summary, get_partner_earnings, join_partner_program, get_balance, rent_gpu, deploy_model, list_images, list_instances, get_events, schedule_removal · Public sink: get_partner_earnings, join_partner_program · Destructive: terminate_instance, schedule_removal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
